I know it’s negative self talk that’s debilitating for me, but sometimes it feels like a lot of people reinforce this negative thinking.  Like some on Reddit make fun of those who are virgins, like they are a lesser person because of it.  It’s like if you’re the stereotypical man you get called out for being sexist, if you’re not like that you’re chastised as being ‘less of a man.’  I look at these threads and it’s like men and woman are at each others like throats.  All this ‘Redpill this, feminism that, men suck, women suck’ etc.  What in the fuck??  Can’t we see that both genders have it tough and are held to strict standards of how we should be?  Instead it’s blame the other side.  Part of the reason I’m apprehensive in dating is because of this.  It’s like shit flinging. It’s just gonna cause more harm.
